quotations: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products.
Getting the device ready for manufacturing still required several rounds of review and iteration.
A newer internal model achieved an average score of 0.875, compared with 0.594 for GPT‑6 Astra at its highest reasoning setting.
Two team members designed this test device with Astra in under a week while working on it as a side project. A contract manufacturer built a small batch of prototypes in under a month.
